thesis.what_must_be_true: Wolfspeed's 200mm fully vertically integrated chain (Durham/Siler City substrates & epitaxy, Marcy 200mm fab, Fayetteville modules) can be sweated without significant incremental capex, with AI-driven manufacturing improvements lifting utilization enough to flip non-GAAP gross margin from deeply negative (-26% GAAP in Q3) toward breakeven by late FY27. The 65% cash interest reduction and ~5-year maturity wall must hold, keeping quarterly interest near $35-40M not $50M+. AI datacenter 30% QoQ momentum and qualification on 200mm must broaden beyond small base to offset soft SiC automotive demand and the wind-down of 150mm (Durham fab closure, $460M total restructuring). Success is visible as revenue stabilizes $148-152M in Q4 then builds to $185M by Q4 FY27, gross loss narrows to breakeven, opex held flat ~$68M, capex restrained to ~$60-65M annually net of CHIPS/ NY subsidies, and free cash flow inflects from -$80M in Q4 toward positive in FY28-29 as 200mm scale and 300mm materials optionality materialize.

validated.preview_note: WOLF enters Q4 FY26 off a fresh-start balance sheet: $1.2B liquidity, debt cut to ~$1.7B and cash interest guided down 65% to $145M annualized, but fundamentals still deeply underwater. Q3 printed $150M revenue in line, gross loss -$40M (-27%), opex $74M flat, op cash -$84M. Guide for Q4 is $140-160M revenue, non-GAAP GM still negative, opex flat. Two things decide the print: (1) whether 200mm qualification and AI datacenter +30% QoQ can hold revenue at midpoint (~$149M) despite auto SiC softness and 150mm wind-down; (2) whether cost actions and AI platform integration actually bend cost of revenue and hold opex near $68M vs creep. Interest should step down to ~$44M GAAP ($36M cash) - any slippage keeps losses elevated. We expect a narrow beat on operating discipline but still negative GM and FCF ~-$80M, with net loss ~-$141M (GAAP -$2.90) and adjusted ~-$1.94. Reaction hinges on Q1 FY27 guide and path to GM breakeven, not the headline loss.

Cash flow proxies: CFO -$83.8M? prior quarter disclosure op cash -$84M, adj EBITDA -$62M, net CapEx $5M net of $33M NY ESD. Guidance page 11: Q4 revenue $140-160M, non-GAAP GM negative, opex flat. Refinancing page 9: GAAP liability down ~$580M to $1.7B, cash interest 65% cut from $400M to $145M, maturities to 2030/2031. Visual page 6-7: vertical integration without much capex, AI platform, 30% QoQ AI datacenter growth, materials 200mm/300mm. Assessment: Demand remains mixed - AI/infra and defense offsetting auto weakness and 150mm exit (RTP fab transferred July 25 2025, Durham 150mm fab ceased Q2 FY26). Utilization still low, so GAAP GM stays negative but sequential improvement via cost and PIK interest mechanics; we model cost $186.5M for -$38M gross, opex $68M flat, interest $44M (down from $52M as PIK accrues but cash step-down begins Jun 23 2026), non-op only interest income -$9M now that derivatives/warrant reclassified to equity in Jan 2026 ($87.9M + $31.5M), pretax -$141M net -$141.3M. Shares jump to 48.8M full quarter effect of Renesas 16.85M + March 3.25M + 2M prefunded warrants. Non-GAAP adds ~$46.5M (stock comp 10.5, restruct 5.5, fresh-start intangible amort 18.2 of $409M base, other). FY26 includes $563M reorg gain making GAAP net small positive $8.7M for full year despite Q4 loss; adjusted excludes it. Quarterly path assumes gradual ramp to $185M by Q4 FY27 as 200mm qualifies, GM crosses positive in Q4 FY27, FCF stays negative until FY28 as capex restrained (~$60M) vs $717M PPE base after $3B fresh-start writedown. Balance sheet rolls mechanically, liabilities edge up with PIK, equity erodes with losses then stabilizes.
